recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit as-is. Future changes to Device.property.type examples or bindings should be handled through later Device binding/use-case issues, not by reopening this typo/correction issue.
issue_request: FHIR-20464 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for FHIR-core Device, raised against STU3 and applied for R5, asking to correct Device.property.type text that referred to a nonexistent and misspelled DeviceDefinitionPropetyCode value set and to clarify that the code specifies the represented property, with MDC as an example source of codes.
initial_application: Commit 439f71f7090850848dd0d27c1800c89b4056edf7, 'Apply Jira issues to Device', appears to be the initial application. It changed the then-authoritative Device spreadsheet Device.property.type short/definition from the bad DeviceDefinitionPropetyCode wording to 'Code that specifies the property being represented' and added an MDC example sentence.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative XML source no longer has the bad value-set reference: Device.property.type says it is the code for the represented property and has an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-property-type. Later Published FHIR-32567 added example binding guidance for Device.property.type, and later OO/source work for FHIR-39322 revised the same Device.property family and removed the old MDC prose from the property.type definition.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing the original MDC sentence would be redundant with, and potentially contrary to, later same-element binding and wording history. The current source satisfies the FHIR-20464 correction by eliminating the nonexistent misspelled value-set reference and preserving the property-being-represented meaning.

related_jiras.note: Published later issue required an example binding or example concepts for Device.property.type, explaining why current guidance belongs in the binding rather than restored MDC prose.
Later OO decision/source work revised Device.property and DeviceDefinition.property wording and removed the previous MDC sentence from Device.property.type; it was used as context only, not decided.
